queries.conclusion: byteCode HAR public Player.native provides generic properties/commands; no ArkTS name whitelist. Convenience absence does not mean wrapper not exposed.
queries.unresolved: C++ binding's native error-return/exception conversion was not proved by Ark bytecode alone.

queries.topic: Identify actual bundled native core before applying upstream semantics
queries.conclusion: Embedded version references the resolved OHOS-support commit, FFmpeg n8.0 and compiled GPU/libplacebo features; matching upstream differs from latest stable.
queries.unresolved: No claim downstream build exactly matches unmodified commit; target runtime remains required.

queries.conclusion: Cache-time returns cache-end timestamp; wrapper buffer passes it through and Linkora stores it as cached duration. INT64 wrapper observation loses subsecond precision. This is a statically established mismatch.
queries.unresolved: Actual unavailable-property/stale-value and fractional conversion behavior needs target confirmation; no fix authorized.

queries.conclusion: Wrapper absolute request has no explicit +exact, but matching manual defaults absolute seeks to exact. Adapter's single seekPending boolean is completed by next playback restart, without request ID.
queries.unresolved: Actual precision and rapid/paused request correlation need controlled native target tests.

queries.conclusion: Native playback restart is playback reinitialization/discontinuity/seek-complete signal. It does not establish first frame physically rendered. Adapter maps it to onFirstFrame once.
queries.unresolved: Rendered frame evidence on real surface and audio-only behavior remain target checks.

queries.topic: OHOS HDR compared with current stable manual
queries.conclusion: Matching core explicitly sets NativeWindow PQ/HLG colorspace and HDR metadata. It is incorrect to infer OHOS absence from stable manual's older platform list.
queries.unresolved: Real metadata API success, display/compositor color path, HDR10/HLG output and Dolby Vision native output are not proven.

queries.conclusion: audio-spdif is native and generically reachable; matching OHAudio AO defaults RAW and coerces to PCM formats. OHAudio encoding_type 0..2 alone is not proof receiver-facing bitstream output.
queries.unresolved: Active AO, encoded transport format/route and receiver behavior need target evidence; verdict NATIVE_PARTIAL, not guessed support.

queries.conclusion: mpv lavf stream sets reconnect=1/reconnect_delay_max=7; configurable FFmpeg HTTP flags cover disconnection/EOF/connect/HTTP errors separately, not universal playback retry.
queries.unresolved: Actual selected protocol path/server Range semantics and retry outcomes require native target fault injection.

queries.conclusion: AVSession/background-task integration is a separate HarmonyOS lifecycle owner. Generic mpv property access does not expose those platform APIs. MPV row NOT_APPLICABLE.
queries.unresolved: Future AVSession/background feature requires separate platform audit/implementation, not a fabricated MPV-native device backlog item.
